terms_of_service_content:
User Agreement
Terms of Use of the Black Diamond Service

1. General Provisions
This User Agreement (hereinafter referred to as the "Agreement") regulates the relations between the Black Diamond service (hereinafter referred to as the "Service") and the user (hereinafter referred to as the "User").

2. Subject of the Agreement
The Service provides a platform for the safe conduct of transactions between users using cryptocurrency as a guarantor of transactions.

3. Rights and Obligations of the User
The User has the right:
To use the service for creating and participating in transactions
To receive technical support
To refuse to use the service at any time
The User is obliged:
To provide accurate information
To comply with the legislation of their country
Not to use the service for illegal purposes
To timely fulfill their obligations under transactions
4. Service Commission
The Service charges a commission of 5-10% of the amount of each successfully completed transaction. The exact commission depends on the type of currency and the amount of the transaction.

5. Guarantees and Liability
The Service guarantees the safety of users' funds during transactions. However, the Service is not responsible for users' actions that violate the law.

6. Limitation of Liability
The Service is not liable for losses resulting from technical failures, actions of third parties, or force majeure circumstances.

7. Change of Terms
The Service reserves the right to change the terms of this agreement. Users will be notified of changes.

8. Contacts
For questions related to this agreement, contact the support service through the chat on the site or Telegram bot.
